dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Your restaurant at a glance will appear here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Manage your profile and how the app looks.

auth.remember: Keep me signed in on this device
auth.sign_in_intro: Enter your email and password. No account yet?
auth.sign_up_intro: Start your free trial. Already have an account?
auth.slug_hint: Your menu will be at {{url}}. Lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens.
auth.forgot_intro: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.reset_link_sent: If an account exists for {{email}}, a link to reset the password is on its way. Check your inbox and spam folder.
auth.password_changed: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.
auth.reset_link_invalid: This reset link is incomplete or has expired.
auth.two_factor_intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.sign_out_confirm: Sign out of your account on this device?
auth.session_expired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
auth.legal: By continuing you agree to the <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

validation.slug: Use 3–50 lower-case letters, numbers and single hyphens, not at the start or end.

verify.banner: Please confirm your email address ({{email}}) using the link we sent you.
verify.sent: A new link was sent to {{email}}.

invite.title: Join {{restaurant}}
invite.invalid: This invitation is no longer valid. Ask the restaurant for a new one.
invite.wrong_account: This invitation was sent to {{invited}}, but you are signed in as {{current}}.
invite.sign_up_intro: Create your account to join the team. Already have one?

no_restaurant.title: No restaurant yet
no_restaurant.text: Your account is not part of any restaurant. Ask an owner or manager to invite you, then open the link in the email.

subscription.grace: Your subscription has expired. Renew by {{date}} to keep editing.
subscription.read_only: Your subscription has expired. The admin is read-only until you renew; the menu goes offline on {{date}}.
subscription.unavailable: Your subscription has expired and your menu is offline. Renew to bring it back.

team.title: Team

role_hint.manager: Managers edit the menu, branches and settings, and can invite staff.
role_hint.staff: Staff mark items sold out. Allow them to edit prices if needed.

team.invite_intro: We will email them a link that is valid for 7 days.
team.pending_intro: Invitations that have not been accepted yet.
team.remove_confirm: Remove {{name}} from the team? They lose access right away.
team.leave_confirm: Leave {{restaurant}}? You will need a new invitation to come back.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.read_only: Your subscription has expired, so changes cannot be saved.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.in_progress: Still saving the previous change. Try again in a moment.
errors.too_many: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

not_found.title: Page not found
not_found.text: The page you are looking for does not exist or was moved.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.text: Your role in this restaurant cannot open this page.

general.title: Something went wrong
general.text: Please try again. If it keeps happening, contact support.

menu.title: Menu
menu.delete_menu_confirm: Delete {{name}} with all its categories and items ({{count}} items)? This cannot be undone.
menu.scheduled_note: Shown at set times only (time windows: {{count}}).
menu.schedule_intro: For example breakfast from 07:00 to 11:00. Times are in the restaurant's time zone.
menu.past_midnight: Runs past midnight into the next day.
menu.name: Name
menu.summary_hint: Shown under the name in the list
menu.no_categories: No categories yet. Add one to start.
menu.delete_category_confirm: Delete {{name}} and its items ({{count}})? This cannot be undone.
menu.item_editor: Edit the item's details, prices, add-ons and tags.
menu.delete_items_confirm: Delete the selected items ({{count}})? This cannot be undone.
menu.percent_hint: Use a minus sign to lower prices, e.g. -5.
menu.sizes_hint: With sizes, guests see each size's price and the list shows the lowest one.
menu.addons_hint: Choices guests can add, such as extra toppings. They are shown as information only.

addons.title: Add-ons
addons.intro: Reusable choices such as extra toppings or milk type, linked to items in the item editor.
addons.delete_confirm: Delete {{name}}? It is removed from the items that use it ({{count}}).
addons.choices_hint: Shown to guests as information, for example "choose up to 2".

tags.title: Tags
tags.own_intro: Your own labels, such as "Chef's pick".
tags.none: No tags of your own yet.
tags.name: Tag name
tags.delete_confirm: Delete {{name}}? It is removed from all items.
